name: Wyoming Interstate Piceance Basin Expansion
researcher_notes: Not in the sheet as its own row. The existing row P0282 (Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline, 800 mi system record) covers the whole system, not this lateral, so this is an expansion row in the P0282 name shape, not a match. The August 2026 EIA pipeline projects release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 396, lists 'WIG Piceance Line' by Wyoming Interstate Gas Co: expansion, completed 28 April 2006, Colorado and Wyoming, 142 miles, 24 inch, 350 MMcf/d additional capacity, cost 136.42 million dollars, FERC docket CP05-54. A Federal Register notice from May 2005 (docket CP05-54) confirms the Piceance Basin Expansion Project by Wyoming Interstate Company; the notice page text did not show the 142 mile figure, so only the project and docket are corroborated and the proposal year of 2005. The two sources are not independent for the length, so confidence is medium. A trade press item (Natural Gas Intelligence, 2005) reportedly gives 142 miles of 24 inch looping from Greasewood Hub to Wamsutter, but it was not verified and is not cited. Owner and parent not staged: no verified source in hand names Kinder Morgan as owner; P0282 carries Kinder Morgan. Route not researched; the route sheet for P0282 should be checked for whether it already includes this lateral. Passes the 25 km length rule (142 mi, about 229 km). Further check suggested: the FERC order or the Kinder Morgan interactive pipeline map for an independent length figure.
